_comment: Payments / paid-services config for bazarish-service-node (--payments-config). Prices are atomic units of the settlement currency (piconero for monerod). Omitted fields fall back to dev defaults.

portal._comment: Onboarding advertised by GET /v1/account/portal. links should list at least one browser URL (mirrors / onion / clearnet). captcha.enabled=false opens free registration to any signed-in key without a captcha.
portal.message: Register on the Bazarish portal to start messaging.
